Has the news of the Overwhelming Day of Judgment reached you?
Some faces on that Day will be humbled.
Working hard and tired.
They will enter a very hot fire.
They will be given a drink from a boiling spring.
They will have no food except a bitter, thorny plant.
It does not feed them and does not stop their hunger.
Other faces on that Day will be happy.
Pleased with their effort in this life.
They will be in a high garden.
They will not hear any useless talk there.
In it there is a flowing spring.
In it there are raised couches.
And cups set out.
And cushions arranged in rows.
And rich carpets spread out.
Do they not look at the camels, and how they were created?
And at the sky, and how it was raised up?
And at the mountains, and how they were set up?
And at the earth, and how it was spread out?
So remind them. You are only a reminder.
You are not a ruler over them.
But whoever turns away and rejects.
Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
Their return is to Us.
Then it is up to Us to take their account.
